name: VIS-001-healthy-dog-no-alarm
description: Photo of a healthy, alert Labrador — no visible wounds, normal posture. The model must NOT trigger false alarms.
message: Here's a photo of Max from today. Does he look okay to you?
notes: Use a clear, well-lit photo. The key assertion is GREEN triage and no false alarms.

name: VIS-002-visible-wound-on-limb
description: Close-up of a dog's foreleg with an open cut / abscess clearly visible. Should trigger ORANGE or RED and vet recommendation.
message: My dog Bella hurt herself at the park, I can see something on her leg. Is this bad?
notes: Accept RED as well — either passes the deterministic check via a separate allow_list; for now expect ORANGE as the minimum.

name: VIS-003-eye-discharge-single-eye
description: Cat photo with discharge visible in one eye. Should be ORANGE with questions about duration and whether it's affecting vision.
message: Luna's left eye looks a bit gunky this morning. Can you see what I mean?
notes: Response should ask about duration / both eyes affected / any changes in behaviour.

name: VIS-004-overweight-cat-no-emergency
description: Clearly round/overweight cat in a relaxed posture. No emergency — but the model should acknowledge the weight concern without over-triaging.
message: Mochi has been eating a lot lately. Does she look like a normal weight to you?
notes: Response should mention weight / body condition score. Must NOT be ORANGE/RED.

name: VIS-005-non-pet-image-graceful
description: User uploads a photo of a houseplant or piece of furniture — no animal visible. Model must not give pet medical advice.
message: I found something on the floor near my cat's bowl. Is this dangerous?
notes: forbid_medical checks that the model does NOT diagnose anything. It should ask what the object is or clarify it cannot see a pet in the image.

name: VIS-006-blurry-image-ask-for-clearer
description: Very blurry, out-of-focus photo where no pet features are discernible. Model should acknowledge the limitation and ask for a clearer photo.
message: Here's a picture of the spot I'm worried about on Charlie's back.
notes: The model should ask for a clearer photo rather than hallucinating a finding.

name: VIS-007-lethargic-labored-breathing
description: Dog lying down in an abnormal posture — visible ribcage movement suggesting laboured breathing, or drooping/dull expression. Should be RED.
message: Rocky has been lying like this for hours and looks really weak. Please help.
notes: HIGH severity case. Requires RED triage AND an alert. Test that urgent action advice is given.

name: VIS-008-skin-rash-belly
description: Dog flipped on its back showing redness / rash / bumps on the belly. Should be ORANGE with dermatology-adjacent advice.
message: Daisy's been scratching her belly a lot. I took this pic. What do you think?
notes: Response should mention possible allergy/irritation and advice on monitoring or vet visit if it persists.

name: VIS-009-food-bowl-photo
description: User uploads a photo of an empty food bowl — no pet visible. Model should ask what the user wants rather than volunteering medical advice.
notes: Model should ask a clarifying question — what does the user want to know — rather than guessing a health concern.

name: VIS-010-text-only-no-images
description: User sends a text-only health question with an empty imageIds array. Must fall back to normal text handling without errors.
message: My cat has been sneezing a lot today. Should I be worried?
notes: This case has NO image_files — it tests that the driver gracefully handles empty imageIds and the backend still returns a coherent text response.
